header: Pokémon Snap's play plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, its regular play of 2-3 minutes with every
timeout counted: the launcher and Load ROM (RT64 starts only once the game does, so no shader list is built behind
this launcher), the boot to the main menu, then the beach, started from the main menu by web/survey.cpp (a need that
fails the run unless the game's scene, Module._snap_web_scene, is the beach), ridden 50 s by web/shader_survey.js's
ride() (the camera out, photos taken, the items thrown), then quit from the pause menu (Start, Quit) as a player
does, into the camera check after it. Zero-One rolls on rails, so nothing is timed on the game's clock. A picture is
taken of the main menu, the beach 8 s in and the camera check. web/play_plan_extended.json goes on to the Volcano and
the Cave, for when a longer play is needed.
